description: This file defines the PatientState entity class in a Java-based healthcare application, representing a patient's state within a program, including properties such as start and end dates, associated program, and encounter details. It includes methods for copying, comparison, and checking activity status.

classes.name: PatientState
classes.description: Entity class representing the state of a patient within a healthcare program, including temporal data, program association, and encounter information, with behaviors for copying, comparison, and activity status checks.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of this PatientState instance without copying the ID, including core properties.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Helper method to copy properties into a target PatientState, allowing subclasses to delegate parts of copying behavior.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Determines if the PatientState is active on a specific date, considering voided status and date range.

methods.name: getActive (no args)
methods.description: Checks if the PatientState is active on the current date.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the PatientState including key properties.

methods.name: getPatientProgram
methods.description: Accessor for the associated PatientProgram.

methods.name: setPatientProgram
methods.description: Mutator for setting the associated PatientProgram.

methods.name: getPatientStateId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this PatientState.

methods.name: setPatientStateId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this PatientState.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Accessor for the ProgramWorkflowState associated with this PatientState.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Mutator for the ProgramWorkflowState.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Accessor for the end date of the PatientState.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Mutator for the end date.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Accessor for the start date.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Mutator for the start date.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Returns the associated Encounter object.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Sets the Encounter associated with this PatientState.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implementation of OpenmrsObject.getId(), returns the PatientState ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the PatientState ID.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares PatientState instances based on start and end dates, and UUID for ordering.
